planets.name: Gliese 12 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Gliese 12 with a 12.8-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: Gliese 12 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Gliese 12. Its orbit and size follow Turner et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
